doctor.headline: 2 problems and 6 warnings found on Paper 1.21.11.

evidence: log: This server is running Paper version 1.21.11-132-ver/1.21.11@c5eb079

sections.title: Conflicts

items.title: /nxclash is claimed by 2 plugins; only one answers /nxclash (the one enabled first, and that order changed between identical boots on node-2), the others only as /<plugin>:nxclash.
items.advice: cannot resolve automatically: user decision (pick which plugin keeps /nxclash; the other stays reachable as /<plugin>:nxclash)

items.title: 2 plugins change or cancel PlayerJoinEvent at the same priority (HIGH); the result depends on plugin load order.
items.advice: Move one handler to a different EventPriority (rebuild for a Cyrus mod), or define the load order with loadbefore.
evidence: TfClashA 1.0.0: dev.nxeon.tf.tfclasha.Main#onJoin changes PlayerJoinEvent at HIGH
TfClashB 1.0.0: dev.nxeon.tf.tfclashb.Main#onJoin changes PlayerJoinEvent at HIGH

items.title: nxclash.use has different defaults (true vs op); who gets it depends on load order.
items.advice: cannot resolve automatically: user decision (set the default explicitly in a permissions plugin such as LuckPerms)

items.title: 2 plugins define the permission nxclash.use; Paper keeps one definition and silently ignores the other (no log line on 1.21.11 or 26.2, seen on real boots), so the other plugin's default and children do not apply.
items.advice: cannot resolve automatically: user decision (keep one, or accept the overlap)
evidence: confirmed by latest.log line 117: Plugin TfClashB v1.0.0 tried to register permission 'nxclash.use' but it's already registered

items.title: 2 plugins want to own the join quit messages; only one can (they overwrite each other).
items.advice: cannot resolve automatically: user decision (keep one join quit messages owner)

couldNotCheck: FabricThing.jar: no plugin descriptor, so names, commands, permissions and dependencies were not checked

sections.title: Known problems

items.title: TfLegacy is a legacy plugin
items.detail: Its plugin.yml has no api-version, so Paper treats it as written for Minecraft 1.12 or older and loads it through a compatibility layer. Such plugins often misbehave on current versions and slow the start. On this server Paper spent 10 s loading its legacy layer at the last start.
items.advice: Look for an up-to-date version of this plugin, or a maintained replacement.
evidence: confirmed by latest.log line 88: Legacy plugin TfLegacy v0.9.0 does not specify an api-version.

items.title: Fabric Thing is a fabric mod, not a plugin
items.detail: It sits in the plugins folder, but it is a fabric mod (it has no plugin.yml). Paper cannot load it: it does nothing and logs an error at every start.
items.advice: Remove it from plugins/. It only works on a fabric server.
evidence: confirmed by latest.log line 16: [DirectoryProviderSource] Error loading plugin: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Directory 'plugins/.paper-remapped/FabricThing.jar' does not contain a paper-plugin.yml or plugin.yml! Could not det

couldNotCheck: known-broken list: no curated entries yet, so specific broken plugin versions were not looked up

items.title: TfBroken crashed while starting
items.detail: It threw an error when it was enabled: java.lang.IllegalStateException: TfBroken deliberately failed in onEnable
items.advice: Update the plugin or check its config; send the log lines to its author.
evidence: latest.log line 122: Error occurred while enabling TfBroken v1.0.0 (Is it up to date?)

items.title: The server could not reach Mojang or PaperMC online services
items.detail: Key or version checks failed with network errors at the last start. Players can still join; if this server should have internet, check its DNS and firewall.
evidence: line 36: Failed to request yggdrasil public key
line 148: [PaperVersionFetcher] Error while parsing version list

sections.title: Performance
sections.summary: TPS is fine and no performance warnings were found
